okJob.querySql: SELECT AVG(sent_bytes) / 300 AS "Bytes Sent", AVG(received_bytes) / 300 AS "Bytes Received", FROM_UNIXTIME(TIME_FLOOR_WITH_FILL(recv_time, 'PT5M', 'zero')) AS "Receive Time" FROM security_event WHERE recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2023-12-22T10:00:00+08:00') AND recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2023-12-23T10:00:00+08:00') AND security_event.vsys_id IN (1) GROUP BY "Receive Time" ORDER BY "Receive Time" ASC
